verdict.rationale: Luma documents reusable automations through Luma Skills ("Build a Creative Workflow Once, Run It Forever") and multi-step Luma Agents workflows, so the axis applies. However, no evidence shows that users can version, review, or roll back those workflows. The only versioning evidence covers Luma's own /v1 API changelog and X-API-Version header, which is platform API versioning rather than user automation history, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
